errors.IMAGE_URL_INVALID: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.

errors.BOUNCE_SILENT: Every track is muted or silent, so there is nothing to bounce.

errors.API_KEY_SCOPE: This API key is not allowed to do that.
errors.API_KEY_LIMIT: You already have the maximum number of API keys. Revoke one first.
errors.DUPLICATE_VERSION: This file is the same as the current version.
errors.UPDATE_PENDING: An update is already waiting or running.
errors.UPDATE_CONFIRM_MISMATCH: The confirmed version is not the one running.
errors.JOB_STATE: The job cannot do that in its current state.
errors.EDIT_SESSION_OPEN: Someone else is already editing this song. You can take the session over.
errors.EDIT_SESSION_STATE: The edit session has already ended. Reload the page.
errors.NOT_SESSION_OWNER: Someone else has taken over this edit session. Your latest changes were not saved.
errors.SONG_EDITING: Someone is editing this song, so this cannot be changed until the session ends.

validation.usernameFormat: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, underscore.

fields.usernameHint: Used to log in; lowercase letters and digits.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.explain: There is no email here. We'll let the admins know, and one of them will send you a reset link (for example by message).
forgot.done: Done. An admin will send you a link to set a new password.

invite.title: Join the band
invite.subtitle: You've been invited as {{role}}. Choose your login details.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: For account @{{username}}. You'll be logged out on all other devices.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailHint: Optional. You can use it to log in instead of your username. BandRoom never sends email.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password logs you out on all other devices.
password.changed: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.

sessions.title: Devices
sessions.description: Devices where you are logged in.

storage.title: Storage
storage.warning: You are running out of space. Ask an admin for a larger quota.

audio.title: Audio
audio.instrumentHint: Used by “Mute my instrument” in the Mixer. Automatic guesses it from your tag.
audio.instrumentTagHint: Optional, e.g. lead: tracks that have a tag must match it.

keyboard.title: Keyboard and pedal
keyboard.description: Map keys of a Bluetooth page-turner pedal (or any key) to song-page actions. Stored on this device; mapped keys replace their default shortcut.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let scripts and plugins (for example a Reaper script) use BandRoom as you. Treat a key like a password.
apiKeys.copyNow: Copy the key now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.nameHint: Where the key is used, e.g. "Reaper on the studio Mac".

users.resetRequests_one: {{count}} user asked for a password reset. Use "Create reset link" in their menu and send them the link.
users.resetRequests_other: {{count}} users asked for a password reset. Use "Create reset link" in their menu and send them the link.
users.resetLinkExplain: Send this link to the user (e.g. by message). It works once and expires in 24 hours.

invites.noteHint: Only admins see this, e.g. "new drummer".
invites.linkExplain: Send this link to the person you are inviting. It works once.
invites.explain: Invite links let people create their own account.

settings.instanceNameHint: Shown in the header and browser tab. Leave empty to use the server default.
settings.defaultRolesExplain: The role users get on every project unless a project or song grant says otherwise.
settings.logoHint: Shown left of the instance name in the header, on the login page and on public links (on phones instead of the name). PNG or WebP with transparency works best; at most {{ratio}}:1.
settings.logoNone: No logo: the header shows the instance name only.
settings.trashRetentionHint: Deleted songs, tracks and versions stay in the Trash this long, then they are deleted permanently and their space is freed.
settings.recordingMaxTakeHint: A recording in the browser stops after this long (1–600 minutes).
settings.recordingPeakTargetHint: When a take is saved, its level is set so the loudest peak reaches this (−24 to 0 dBFS). Can be changed per take.

import.title: Import from Samply
import.explain: Copy projects from your Samply account: songs, versions, stems, documents and comments. Re-running later adds only new items.

connect.title: Connect to Samply
connect.keyHint: Create a key in Samply under Preferences → API. It is stored encrypted for this import and deleted when it finishes or is cancelled, unless you remember it below.
connect.ownedOnly: Only projects you own in Samply are listed. Projects others shared with you must be imported by their owners, or ownership transferred in Samply first.
connect.rememberHint: Saved encrypted for your account only, after Samply accepts it. Only its last four characters are shown again.

select.title: Choose projects
select.explain: Pick the projects to import. They are scanned first; nothing is copied until you start the import.
select.empty: This Samply account owns no projects.

progress.dryRunning: Dry run: checking what would be imported…
progress.cancelExplain: Whatever was already imported stays. To import again, connect with your Samply API key again.

review.title: Review what will be created
review.explain: Each Samply item has a proposed role. Change it where the guess is wrong, then run a dry run or start the import.
review.existing: Imported before — only new items are added
review.insights: Also import Samply insights (plays, shares; latest 100 per project) into the activity log
review.groupHint: Nothing is grouped automatically. To make stems of one recording a single multitrack song, tick the items and choose “Make multitrack song”. Lengths may differ: the tracks start together.
review.differentLength: Lengths differ: the tracks start together, shorter ones end earlier.
review.artworkHint: Samply lists the project picture as a file. It becomes the project image; choose Document only if you also want it as a document.
review.artworkUnavailable: This Samply project picture can’t be imported: the Samply API doesn’t provide it. After the import, upload it in the project’s settings.

report.title: Report
report.unmatched: Comment authors without an account here
report.unmatchedExplain: Their comments were kept as "Name (imported)". Invite them to link future comments.

apiKeys.explain: Every user's API keys. Revoking one stops it at once.

updates.explain: Deploy a newer release or go back to the previous one. The server's update watcher runs the update; the app only asks for it.
updates.watcherMissing: The update watcher on the server hasn't reported; updates won't run.
updates.watcherStale: The update watcher on the server last reported {{when}}; updates won't run until it reports again.
updates.olderHint: To go back to an older version, use Rollback.
updates.deployBody: The server first makes a database backup, then restarts the app with {{tag}} (currently {{running}}). Expect about a minute of downtime; everyone's open pages will reconnect.
updates.rollbackBody: The server goes back to the version that ran before {{running}} and restores the database backup taken just before {{running}} was deployed. Everything changed since then (uploads, comments, edits) is lost from the database; the current database is backed up first. Expect about a minute of downtime.
updates.rollbackType: Type the running version ({{running}}) to confirm
updates.restarting: The app is restarting… This page will reconnect by itself.

export.title: Export project
export.skippedSongs_one: {{count}} song is left out: its download policy does not allow you.
export.skippedSongs_other: {{count}} songs are left out: their download policy does not allow you.
export.opusFallback_one: {{count}} track has no full-quality files and comes as Opus.
export.opusFallback_other: {{count}} tracks have no full-quality files and come as Opus.
export.originalFallback_one: {{count}} track was uploaded lossy and comes as the uploaded file.
export.originalFallback_other: {{count}} tracks were uploaded lossy and come as the uploaded files.
export.busy: WAV files are rebuilt while downloading; one WAV export or download runs at a time.

projects.reducedExplain: You can see only the songs that were shared with you.

fields.name: Name
fields.downloadPolicyHint: Original/lossless downloads. Listening is always allowed.

settings.ownershipExplain: Current owner: {{name}}. The new owner also becomes a manager.
settings.deleteExplain: The project and all its songs go to the Trash and disappear for everyone. An admin can restore it from Admin → Trash until it is deleted permanently.
settings.imageHint: Shown on the project card and on the lock screen while listening. Pick a file or paste an image address, then choose the square to use.
settings.imageUploaded: Image uploaded. It will appear in a moment.
settings.imageUrlHint: A direct link to a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF image (up to 20 MB). The server downloads it for cropping; nothing is kept until you upload.

crop.title: Crop image
crop.hint: Drag the square to move it and a corner to resize it. With the keyboard: arrow keys move, + and − resize, Shift for bigger steps.
crop.unreadable: This browser cannot read the image. Try a PNG or JPEG.
crop.selectionLabel: Square selection. Arrow keys move it, + and − resize it.

songs.deleteExplain: The song goes to the trash and disappears for everyone.
songs.tracksComing: Tracks, versions and the player arrive in a later milestone.
songs.dropFolderHint: Each folder becomes a song and its audio files become tracks. A single file becomes a song with one track, named after the file. A ZIP is unpacked: its subfolders become songs, its loose files one song named after the ZIP.

lock.lockHint: Lock the song: markers, sections, comments, the default mix, version gains and the tempo map can then not be changed by anyone
lock.banner: This song is locked: markers, sections, comments, the default mix, version gains and the tempo map cannot be changed.

grants.title: Members & roles
grants.projectExplain: Roles apply to all songs of this project unless a song says otherwise.
grants.songExplain: Override the project role for this song only, e.g. share one song with a guest or hide it from someone.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.dropHint: Drop audio files here or tap to upload
tracks.dropFormats: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, ALAC, WavPack, MP3, AAC, Ogg, Opus or a ZIP of them · each file becomes a track
tracks.zipFailed: {{name}} could not be unpacked (damaged, encrypted, or larger than 4 GB).
tracks.zipLarge: This ZIP is large. Unpacking it needs a lot of memory on this device; if the upload fails, upload the folders instead.
tracks.skippedNonAudio: Some files were skipped because they are not audio.

errors.quota: Not enough storage: {{remaining}} left. Ask {{admins}} for more.

fields.name: Name
fields.instrumentTagHint: Optional, e.g. lead or rhythm: “Mute my instrument” then also matches the tag.

match.title: Where should these files go?
match.explain: Files matching an existing track become its new version. Change anything before uploading.

listen.nothingToPlay: No song in this project has audio ready to play yet.
listen.songDeleted: The song was deleted, so playback stopped.
listen.projectDeleted: The project was deleted, so playback stopped.

timeline.detail: Timeline: tap to jump, drag to scroll, pinch or Ctrl+scroll to zoom

bounce.title: Bounce to new song
bounce.explain: The server renders the mix you hear now — mutes, solos, volumes, pans and the versions in the Player — into a new song with one track, right after this one. This song stays as it is. The new file counts toward your storage.
bounce.name: Title of the new song
bounce.started: The new song is being rendered
bounce.alwaysCopied: Subtitle and key are copied; comments, documents and sharing are not.

rehearse.strugglingTip: Try a lower quality or mute tracks you don't need.
rehearse.interrupted: Playback was interrupted. Tap play to continue.
rehearse.lockHint: Playback stops when the screen locks or you switch apps. To keep the screen on while playing, use “Keep screen on” in the ⋯ menu.
rehearse.noTracks: No tracks are ready to play yet. You can still set the tempo and play the click.
rehearse.startFailed: Audio could not be started on this device.
rehearse.versionGainHint: Before the fader, for everyone and in bounces.
rehearse.setInstrument: Set your instrument in Settings → Audio to use this.

quality.title: Quality
quality.preferLossless: Prefer lossless on this device (automatic, desktop)

rehearse.saveDefaultsHint: Makes this gain, pan and mute the starting mix for everyone. Personal mixes stay as they are.

markers.addSectionHint: Select a range first: drag in the ruler (or long-press, then drag).
markers.snapMusicalLater: Bars and beats: set a tempo first
markers.chipLabel: {{name}}: tap to jump, double tap to loop
markers.loopDisabled: Loop: select a range or play inside a section
markers.name: Name
markers.badTimes: Enter times as m:ss.mmm; a section must end after it starts.
markers.anchorMusicalHint: Moves with the music when the tempo changes.

timelineItems.title: Markers, sections and comments
timelineItems.selectHint: Select items to convert, recolor or delete them together.
timelineItems.skipped: Skipped: {{count}} (no next marker or song end).

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.pedalHint: Bluetooth pedals: map their keys in Settings → Keyboard and pedal.

actions.returnToStart: Return to loop start, play start, then song start
actions.abToggle: A/B toggle of the selected track
actions.zoomToLoop: Zoom to the loop or selection
actions.pageTurn: Next / previous page in a focused document
actions.editSplit: Edit mode: split at the playhead or the selection
actions.editCut: Edit mode: cut the selection (Shift: silence)
actions.editGain: Edit mode: gain of the selection
actions.editUndo: Edit mode: undo / redo (Ctrl+Y redoes too)
actions.editEscape: Edit mode: clear the picked regions, then the selection

tempo.title: Tempo
tempo.tapHint: Tap at least 4 times in time with the music.
tempo.offsetHint: Where the first downbeat is in the recording.
tempo.alignHint: While playing, tap “Bar 1 is here” on the first downbeat.

errors.meter: Enter a time signature like 4/4 or 6/8.
errors.bpm: Enter a tempo between 20 and 400 BPM.
errors.firstNotZero: The first tempo must start at bar 1.
errors.order: Two changes are at the same position.
errors.meterOffBar: Time signature changes must start on a bar line.
errors.rampAtEnd: The last tempo cannot be a ramp.
errors.bar: Enter a whole bar number from 2 to 9999.
errors.beat: Enter a beat that lies within the bar.
errors.duplicate: Two changes are at the same bar and beat.
errors.meterOffBeat: A time signature change must start on beat 1 of its bar.

tempo.removed: Tempo map removed (it stays in the history)

midi.explain: Import the tempo map from a MIDI file exported by Reaper (File → Export project MIDI) or Logic (Export → Selection as MIDI File). MIDI time 0 is the song start.

warnings.meterRounded: A time signature change was not on a bar line and was moved to bar {{bar}}.
warnings.tempoClamped: A tempo of {{bpm}} BPM was limited to the supported range.
warnings.tooManyMarkers: Only the first 500 of {{count}} markers can be imported.
warnings.noTempo: The file has no tempo; 120 BPM is assumed.

midi.replaces: This replaces the current tempo map (it stays in the history).
midi.importMarkers_one: Import {{count}} marker as a song marker

click.accent: Accent the first beat of the bar
click.soloExcludes: Soloing a track mutes the click

comments.title: Comments
comments.placeholder: Write a comment… Use @ to mention someone.
comments.author: Author
comments.empty: No comments yet. Press “Comment at playhead” while listening.
comments.truncated: Showing the first {{n}} comments; this song has more.
comments.loadVersionsHint: Open the Mixer to load those versions.

notifications.quotaDetail: Delete old versions or ask an admin for more space.
notifications.resetDetail: Create a reset link in Admin → Users.

types.quota_warning: You have used {{percent}} % of your storage
types.link_password_failed: Someone entered a wrong password for the link “{{link}}”
types.link_comment: {{actor}} commented on {{song}} through a public link

toast.mention: You were mentioned in a comment.
toast.comment_on_upload: New comment on a song you uploaded to.
toast.new_version: New version in a song you follow.
toast.new_song: New song in a project you follow.
toast.reset_request: A user asks for a new password.
toast.new_document: New document in a project you follow.
toast.link_password_failed: Wrong password on one of your links.
toast.link_comment: New comment through one of your links.
toast.edit_bounced: New songs made from an edit in a project you follow.

follow.songHint: Get notified about new versions in this song
follow.projectHint: Get notified about new songs in this project

documents.title: Title
documents.textHint: Plain text in a monospace font: spacing is kept (chords over lyrics).
documents.emptyProject: No project documents yet: a setlist, contacts or band rules.
documents.editLoadFailed: The text could not be loaded, so it cannot be edited now. Close and try again.
documents.discardHint: Your edits have not been saved.
documents.failed: This file could not be processed.
documents.noPreview: No preview for this file type.
documents.tooBig: Too large to show here; download it instead.
documents.gone: This document is no longer available.
documents.pdfError: This PDF could not be opened.

links.title: Public links
links.songExplain: Share this song with people outside the band: a link that opens without an account.
links.projectExplain: Links to the whole project and to its songs. Visitors need no account; they can only listen (and comment, if you allow it).
links.adminExplain: Every public link on this instance.
links.createdExplain: Copy the link and send it to whoever should listen. You can copy it again later from the list.
links.revokeExplain: Revoking ends access for everyone who has the link, right away. It cannot be undone; create a new link instead.
links.expiryInPast: Pick a date from today on.
links.policyBlocksDownload: The download policy of this project or song only lets contributors or editors download, so visitors cannot download despite this setting.
links.noVersions: This song has no versions yet.

fields.label: Name
fields.labelHint: Only the band sees it, e.g. who the link is for.
fields.passwordHint: Send the password separately. Visitors stay unlocked for 12 hours.
fields.allowDownloadHint: Original, FLAC, WAV and Opus files, if the download policy lets viewers download.
fields.allowCommentsHint: Visitors enter a name and can leave time-coded comments.
fields.showCommentsHint: Off: visitors only see comments made through this link.

analytics.title: Analytics · {{label}}
analytics.noActivity: Nobody has opened this link yet.
analytics.playsHint: A play is counted when playback starts (once per visitor, song and mode). Listening completion follows with playback tracking.

view.unavailable: It may have expired or been switched off, or the address is incomplete. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.
view.passwordExplain: This link is protected. Enter the password you were given.
view.privacy: Your visits, plays and comments are logged for the band.
view.noSongs: There are no songs here yet.
view.songMissing: This song is not part of the link.
view.nothingYet: There is nothing to listen to yet.

offline.indicatorHint: You're offline. Songs you made available offline still play; comments and edits are sent when you're back online.

update.title: A new version of BandRoom is available.

offline.needsNetwork: Needs a connection. Try again when you're online.
offline.adminNeedsNetwork: You're offline. Admin changes need a connection.
offline.logoutNeedsNetwork: Logging out needs a connection. Try again when you're online.
offline.unsupported: This browser can't keep songs offline.
offline.downloadFailed: “{{title}}” could not be downloaded. The Offline page shows why.

modal.title: Make available offline
modal.songExplain: Downloads the current version of every track, the mix, markers, tempo map, comments and the project's documents, so the song plays with or without the Mixer without a connection.
modal.projectExplain: Downloads every song of this project (current versions, mixes, markers, comments) and its documents.
modal.estimateFailed: The size could not be worked out. Check your connection.
modal.toDownload: ({{size}} still to download, the rest is already on this device.)

storage.unknown: This browser does not report how much space is used.
storage.persisted: Offline data is kept (the browser will not delete it on its own).
storage.notPersisted: The browser may delete offline data when space runs low. Installing the app helps.

install.browserMenu: To install BandRoom, use your browser's menu ("Install app" or "Add to Home Screen").
install.iosTitle: Add BandRoom to your Home Screen
install.iosWhy: On iPhone and iPad, Safari may delete offline songs of websites that are not on the Home Screen.
install.iosStep3: Open BandRoom from the new icon and make songs available offline there

outbox.pending_one: {{count, number}} change made offline is waiting to be sent.
outbox.pending_other: {{count, number}} changes made offline are waiting to be sent.
outbox.sent_one: {{count, number}} change made offline was sent.

outbox.dropped_other: {{count, number}} changes made offline could not be applied (deleted or changed on the server meanwhile).
outbox.locked_one: {{count, number}} change made offline was not applied because the song is locked.
outbox.locked_other: {{count, number}} changes made offline were not applied because the song is locked.

offline.emptyHint: Open a song or project and choose “Make available offline”.
offline.removeAllExplain: Every offline song and project is removed from this device. You can download them again when you're online.

defaults.title: New downloads
defaults.explain: Quality used when you make songs available offline on this device.

logout.title: Log out?
logout.explain: Logging out removes your offline data from this device:
logout.unsent_one: {{count, number}} change made offline has not been sent yet and will be lost.
logout.unsent_other: {{count, number}} changes made offline have not been sent yet and will be lost.

offline.goneProject: The project “{{title}}” was deleted, so its offline copy was removed from this device.

tooltip.failed_one: {{count}} file could not be processed; upload it again or open the song to retry.
tooltip.failed_other: {{count}} files could not be processed; upload them again or open the song to retry.
tooltip.processing_one: {{count}} file is being processed (waveform, streaming versions).
tooltip.processing_other: {{count}} files are being processed (waveform, streaming versions).
tooltip.queued_one: {{count}} file is waiting to be processed.
tooltip.queued_other: {{count}} files are waiting to be processed.

trash.title: Trash
trash.explain: Deleted songs, tracks, versions and documents stay here for {{days}} days, then they are deleted permanently and their space is freed.
trash.adminExplain: Deleted projects, and deleted songs, tracks, versions and documents of every project. They are deleted permanently after {{days}} days (Settings).
trash.restoreNeedsSong: The song is in the Trash and you cannot restore it.
trash.purgeExplain_one: {{count}} item will be deleted for good, with its files, comments and markers. This cannot be undone.
trash.purgeExplain_other: {{count}} items will be deleted for good, with their files, comments and markers. This cannot be undone.
trash.purged: Deleted permanently. {{size}} freed; the files are removed within a few minutes.
trash.notAllowed_one: {{count}} item stays: you may not do this with it.
trash.notAllowed_other: {{count}} items stay: you may not do this with them.
trash.sharedWithCopy: files shared with a copy stay

selection.notYours_one: {{count}} selected item is not yours, so it stays.
selection.notYours_other: {{count}} selected items are not yours, so they stay.
selection.managersOnly_one: Only project managers can delete songs; {{count}} stays.
selection.managersOnly_other: Only project managers can delete songs; {{count}} stay.

lossless.lossySource: Lossy source: it was uploaded compressed (e.g. MP3).
lossless.songAllHint: Every track's current version is compressed only.
lossless.songPartialHint: Some tracks' current versions are compressed only.
lossless.title: Remove full quality?
lossless.explain: The full-quality files (FLAC, WAV and kept originals) are deleted. The compressed audio, waveforms, comments and markers stay, and everything still plays. This cannot be undone.
lossless.nothing: Nothing to remove: the selected versions have no full-quality files left.
lossless.diskShared: Some files are shared with identical uploads, so the disk gets {{disk}} back.
lossless.diskNone: These files are shared with identical uploads, so no disk space comes back yet.

skipped.notReady_one: {{count}} version is still processing (or failed) and stays.
skipped.notReady_other: {{count}} versions are still processing (or failed) and stay.

lossless.lossyExplain: For a compressed upload (e.g. MP3) the original is the only full-quality copy; only the app's own compressed audio stays.
lossless.copies_one: {{count}} other version (a copy) shares these files and loses its full quality too.
lossless.copies_other: {{count}} other versions (copies) share these files and lose their full quality too.
lossless.done_one: Full quality removed from {{count}} version; {{size}} freed.
lossless.done_other: Full quality removed from {{count}} versions; {{size}} freed.
lossless.notAllowed_one: {{count}} selected item has versions that are not yours, so it stays.
lossless.notAllowed_other: {{count}} selected items have versions that are not yours, so they stay.
lossless.convertedOnUpload: Converted to lossy on upload on {{date}}.
lossless.convertedOnUploadBy: Converted to lossy on upload on {{date}} by {{name}}.
lossless.reencodedOn: Re-encoded and full quality removed on {{date}}.
lossless.reencodedOnBy: Re-encoded and full quality removed on {{date}} by {{name}}.
